message: test(saves): reconstruct legacy chest populations independently from current spawn policy
purpose: The migration test assumed today's fresh realm still creates all three historical chests per zone. Reconstruct those old records explicitly and retain full position, non-position state, and idempotence checks.

replacements.old: // Reconstruct SeedWorld's unchanged placement rules with the historical tile policy.
replacements.new:
// Reconstruct historical placement and chest records independently from
    // the current fresh-world population policy. Retired records must still load.

replacements.old: for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) state.Chests[$"{zone.Id}/chest/{i}"].Position = OldFree(zone, new(zone.Spawn.X + 10 + i * 6, zone.Spawn.Y - 8 - i * 3));

var loaded = new RealmEngine(catalog, Wire.Copy(state));
    Assert(loaded.State.Creatures.Values.All(c => WorldMap.Fits(catalog.Zone(c.Zone), c.Position) && WorldMap.Fits(catalog.Zone(c.Zone), c.Home)), "Legacy seeded creature remains blocked.");
